Name: More Double Bed Styles
Author: Vickamoose
Description:
This mod requires Content Patcher, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/912]Hojichas' Walls and Floors[/url] is recommended. To use: unzip into your mods folder.

Of course, there are so many bed styles and preferences out there that it would be impossible for me to do them all, so feel free to use the included Photoshop/ Fire Alpaca. I do plan on adding different bedding and pillow sets to these beds as well.

You're welcome to recommend me any bed styles you'd like! 

The config options are the exact same as the file names: 
﻿Asian_wood
﻿Blue_upholstery
﻿Futon
﻿Gold_pipe ﻿
﻿Green_upholstery
﻿Iron
﻿Minimalistic
﻿Round_wood
﻿Square_wood
﻿Yellow_upholstery

Because some beds have a lower headboard than the original or none at all, make sure to set the Wallpaper in the config to match what you have. There is a reference photo of what wallpaper is which number. I currently use Hojichas', so if you'd like to use a different set you'll need to do some copy-pasting as you'll see in the Wallpaper Backgrounds file. Hopefully in the future, I can find a way to make this less clunky, but this is my quick fix for now.
